notes: The 1cs suffix on שָׂרַי is `unrepresented` because the ASV writes no possessive for it; the margin's *my princes in Issachar* was read and set aside (rules 18, 38).
The waw of וְיִשָּׂשכָר takes the written *As* and כֵּן the *so*: two English words answer to two morphemes and neither is a surplus (rule 14).
The two elliptical cola have wholly elided predicates, so each construction-supplied copula joins the clause's sole overt anchor (rules 20, 34).
